system.description:
Bewitches heart and mind in intrigues: attack the lower of Intrigue or Sorcery Defense, use Will in place of Persuasion or Deception, and Will in place of Status for fast intrigues.

Spell. Bewitching, Seeming or Terror: Greater Action, Spellcasting against Sorcery Defense. Each degree adds +1 Influence with certain techniques; failure turns the target against you.

Ritual. Alignment: Web of Influence: Challenging (9) Knowledge, 1 hour. Invocation: Formidable (12) Will, 1 hour. Unleashing: Will against the target's Sorcery Defense: a lasting bewitchment woven into a chosen intrigue.

Art of Malediction — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 102.
system.resonances: None (spell), or a link to the target (ritual).
